name: Form Clarification (Web)
implementation_notes: The Clarification Detail grid is fully dynamic -- addDetailRow()/removeDetailRow()/canAddRow()/availableTimeSlotOptions() on FormClarification.php, exactly mirroring FormBoilerRoom's grid. Grid starts empty on create mode; edit mode loads existing rows verbatim with each row's id

All 7 non-time_slot columns per row are genuinely editable, never disabled -- Clarification has no computed detail-grid fields and NO enum dropdowns at all (unlike Boiler Room's 2 Y/N selects): 6 are numeric inputs, 1 (Findings) is a plain text input
UNLIKE Form Threshing Web: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no query, no reference data of any kind
Route /data/clarification/create registered BEFORE /data/clarification/{id} (screen-109) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}
checked/acknowledged self-attestation checkboxes mirror FormBoilerRoom's dual-checkbox pattern (both Checked By AND Acknowledged By)
NoActiveClarificationStationException (mirrors NoActiveBoilerRoomStationException) thrown when production_line_id has no active station type=clarification

REVISI (tech-spec v2, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): ClarificationRecordService::create() memanggil assertPeriodOpenForWrite('clarification', station->business_unit_id, date) setelah validasi & resolve station dan sebelum penulisan pertama; update() memanggilnya dua kali (tanggal lama record dan tanggal baru dari body) setelah findOrFail/cek akses/validasi — jadi memindahkan record keluar dari periode tertutup juga ditolak. Penolakan = PeriodClosedException 422 PERIOD_CLOSED dengan salah satu dari 4 pesan (belum ada periode / masih Draft / sudah ditutup / di luar rentang + rentang yang berlaku), nol baris tersimpan. FormClarification::save() menangkap HttpException dan menampilkan pesannya sebagai alert halaman ($generalError). Test yang menutupnya: tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan + cek statis ke-18 service) dan tests/Feature/Api/KelolaPeriodePelaporanTest.php (end-to-end via Sterilizer); test per-layar (tests/Unit/Services/ClarificationRecordServiceTest.php, tests/Feature/Api/FormClarificationTest.php, tests/Feature/Livewire/FormClarificationTest.php) membuka periode Terbuka sebagai prasyarat via openPeriodFor()/openPeriodForStation(). test_results tidak diubah (suite tidak dijalankan ulang untuk sinkronisasi ini).
